title: Stat collecting
description: Instrumentation + b-roll pack: every 30s log wave/coins/rates/diamonds to CSV; every 5 minutes record 20s of footage and log the clip. Does not open, switch, or close upgrade tabs.
notes: Walkthrough reviews both ticks. B-roll outranks the 30s stat event while ffmpeg is recording. Clips: runs/clips/; sheets: runs/stat_collect.csv + runs/stat_broll.csv.
